accepted_results: Proposition 2.1: coherent triangle extension of the full shifted parity inclusion implies graded derived-Hom comparison in every degree; conditional existence only.
Proposition 3.1: t-exactness gives an exact heart functor and Ext comparison in degrees zero and one; higher Yoneda Ext comparison requires the stipulated canonical realization comparisons.
Lemma 3.2: the assumed local t-exact functors and star/shriek restriction comparisons imply global t-exactness.
The finite-dimensional one-affine-stratum and finite open-and-closed disjoint-union cases are completely constructed.
The dg null-homotopy calculation identifies a choice-dependent coherence requirement, not a geometric obstruction example.
limitations: No construction of the general coherent triangle functor.
No proof of general t-exactness or higher heart realization beyond stated hypotheses.
Published finite-flag and restricted affine-flag cases are pre-existing literature.
Mathematical acceptance is a reasoned review, not a formal proof certificate; integrity tests certify bytes only.
